description: Authorises a partner's domain to send their customer notifications: the DKIM public key on the resend._domainkey selector, plus the MX and SPF on the fixed send subdomain. Both variables come from the sending-domain registration. The SPF entry merges into an existing SPF record rather than replacing it.
variableDescription: domainKey: the DKIM public key body (the part after p=). region: the sending region, one of us-east-1, eu-west-1, sa-east-1, ap-northeast-1; it only completes the fixed feedback-smtp MX host.
